recommended_option_id.description: Must be one of the option_id values in the input. Never invent an option.

reasoning_summary.description: One or two sentences. If the pick is not the highest net_recovery_inr, say why.

confidence.description: 0 to 1. Lower it when forecast error (mape) is high or inputs look inconsistent.

explanation.description: Plain-language explanation for a store manager, in English, using only numbers from the input.

explanation_local.description: The same explanation in the requested local language.
